aap-reading.title: How to Share Books with Children 2 and 3 Years Old
aap-reading.scope_note: Shared reading and optional talking about stories; no experimental evidence about these original stories.

zero3-reading.title: Read Early and Often
zero3-reading.scope_note: General early-childhood reading context; no measured outcome from episodic TTS fiction.

cat-excavator.title: 325 Hydraulic Excavator
relevant_sections: Boom and stick, bucket and swing
cat-excavator.scope_note: Equipment terminology and functional capabilities; child-level storytelling is paraphrased, not model-specific.

cat-dump.title: Truck Dump Body (571-8596)
cat-dump.scope_note: Dump body holds and tips material; not an operational instruction for construction machinery.

cat-dozer.title: Small Dozer Operator Assist
cat-dozer.scope_note: Dozer blade pushes and levels material; no exact equipment model asserted in fiction.

cat-loader.title: Wheel Loader or Backhoe Loader: What’s Best for Your Job?
relevant_sections: Wheel loaders: Move large amounts of material efficiently
cat-loader.scope_note: Wheel loaders use buckets to lift and move loose construction material.

cat-roller.title: CS5 (04A) Vibratory Soil Compactor
cat-roller.scope_note: Smooth-drum roller used for compaction of granular soils; not a universal design guide.

nap-bridge.title: Bridge Construction Inspection Training Resources and Practices
nap-bridge.author_or_publisher: National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine
nap-bridge.scope_note: Supports bridge foundations and support roles; not a detailed design specification for the fictional bridge.

fhwa-prefab.title: Chapter 2 — Superstructure Connections: Connection Details for Prefabricated Bridge Elements and Systems
fhwa-prefab.scope_note: Explains prefabricated bridge-element placement and variability of installation; supports sequence in simplified original fiction, not a real design.

fhwa-cranes.title: Chapter 1 — General Topics: Connection Details for Prefabricated Bridge Elements and Systems
fhwa-cranes.scope_note: Supports crane site access and crane-location considerations; no lift-plan details or capacity claims are given.

nrmca-concrete.title: About Concrete
nrmca-concrete.scope_note: Supports truck drum agitation and discharge, and the distinction between fresh mixed concrete and finished support. No site-specific mix design.

anu-paper-bridge.title: Paper Bridge Challenge — Science of Strong Shapes
anu-paper-bridge.author_or_publisher: Australian National University, College of Science and Medicine
relevant_sections: How to build a paper bridge
anu-paper-bridge.scope_note: Supports comparing flat and folded paper over two supports under small weights; this source does not test learning from a fictional story.

psu-farmwatch.title: The Joy of Farm Watching: A Roadside Guide to Pennsylvania Agriculture
psu-farmwatch.scope_note: Tractors provide mobile pulling power for farm wagons and machinery. Supports a particular fictional red tractor, not an assertion about every tractor type.

unh-haymaking.title: Haymaking
unh-haymaking.author_or_publisher: University of New Hampshire Cooperative Extension (John C. Porter)
unh-haymaking.scope_note: Supports the sequence mowing, drying and tedding, raking into windrows, baling when suitable, and storing hay under cover. No real equipment operating directions given in the fiction.

umd-hay-drying.title: Optimizing Drying for Hay and Baleage
umd-hay-drying.scope_note: Supports the need for cut forage to lose moisture and for air and light exposure to speed drying. Not a claim about weather on the fictional farm.

ncsu-hay-production.title: Hay Production — Forage Conservation Techniques
ncsu-hay-production.scope_note: Describes the different functions of hay tedders and rakes in field drying and windrow preparation.

umn-hay-storage.title: Preserving the Value of Dry Stored Hay
umn-hay-storage.scope_note: Dry hay should be baled at suitable moisture and protected from precipitation and wet ground during storage. Exact limits are not voiced in these stories.

cornell-hay.title: Making Hay While the Sun Shines
cornell-hay.scope_note: Describes equipment and steps of traditional dry-hay harvest, including small bale handling.

aaa-flatbed-towing.title: Flatbed vs. Wheel-Lift Vehicle Towing
aaa-flatbed-towing.scope_note: A tilt-bed carrier can load a non-running light van with a winch, secure it and transport it to a repair shop. No mechanical instructions for children.

nhtsa-tires.title: Tire Safety Ratings and Awareness | TireWise
nhtsa-tires.scope_note: Gauges provide information about tire pressure and appropriate tire inflation; tread contributes to grip. Exact pressure for fictional vehicles is deliberately unspecified.

ali-lift-use.title: How to Safely Use a Car Lift or Truck Lift
ali-lift-use.scope_note: Adult operators verify lift pad placement at proper vehicle lifting points and keep bay clear. These fictional stories contain no lift-use procedure.

bridgestone-tires.title: How to Buy Tires
bridgestone-tires.scope_note: Wide tread grooves can channel water away from a tire footprint on wet roads. Toy-wheel tracks in clay are an imaginative activity, not a controlled tire test.

aaa-mobile-battery.title: AAA Roadside Assistance: Mobile Battery Service
relevant_sections: What to expect during a mobile battery service
aaa-mobile-battery.scope_note: A technician can test, jump-start or replace a failing automotive battery on location and recycle the used battery. This fictional red tractor is checked by a professional.

aaa-roadside.title: AAA Roadside Assistance: Roadside Repair Services
aaa-roadside.scope_note: Mobile assistance comes to the vehicle to diagnose battery problems and attempt small repairs; a larger vehicle problem may instead require a tow to a shop.

knapheide-box-bodies.title: Knapheide box truck body catalog, including rear roll-up doors
knapheide-box-bodies.author_or_publisher: Knapheide (catalog presented through Schumacher Chevy Work Truck Solutions)
knapheide-box-bodies.scope_note: Box trucks have enclosed cargo bodies, often with roll-up rear access; no model-specific capacities or dimensions are asserted.

ccohs-hand-trucks.title: Manual Materials Handling: Hoisting and Moving Heavy Objects
ccohs-hand-trucks.author_or_publisher: Canadian Centre for Occupational Health and Safety
relevant_sections: Carts, dollies, hand trucks, and trolleys
ccohs-hand-trucks.scope_note: Hand trucks carry bulky containers a short distance. The fictional driver is an adult; no instructions for children.

traffix-stackable-cones.title: PVC Cone Product Bulletin
traffix-stackable-cones.scope_note: Certain hollow traffic cones are designed to nest in a compact stack, as the fictional four cones do. No road-traffic control instructions are taught.

nasa-rain-gauge.title: Reading a Rain Gauge
nasa-rain-gauge.scope_note: A rain gauge collects precipitation and allows a rainfall depth reading; no measurements are made before it rains.

nws-rain-siting.title: SWOP Rainfall Measuring Tips
relevant_sections: Tip #1: Place the gauge in an open area
nws-rain-siting.scope_note: A rain gauge needs adequate open exposure and should not be placed beneath a tree canopy or building overhang.

hiab-liftgate.title: WALTCO Liftgates — Delivery Made Easy
relevant_sections: Liftgate platform for loading and unloading
hiab-liftgate.scope_note: An adult-operated liftgate moves a load between truck-bed height and the ground; it is not for children to operate or ride.

umn-chicken-feed.title: Caring for chickens in cold weather
umn-chicken-feed.scope_note: Chickens need complete balanced feed and dry, protected feed storage. The story does not use sheep hay as a replacement for chicken feed.

lsu-wheelbarrow.title: Wheelbarrows and Garden Carts
relevant_sections: Single front wheel and two handles
lsu-wheelbarrow.scope_note: Traditional one-wheeled wheelbarrows carry soil, mulch, tools, and other materials in farm and garden work; some designs have two wheels, but the story describes one specific traditional wheelbarrow.

fmcsa-cargo-securement.title: Cargo Securement Rules
relevant_sections: Prevent shifting on or within vehicles
fmcsa-cargo-securement.scope_note: Commercial vehicle loads should be properly secured so cargo does not shift. No carrier-specific regulatory compliance claim or instruction is made.

usgs-runoff.title: Surface Runoff and the Water Cycle
usgs-runoff.author_or_publisher: U.S. Geological Survey, Water Science School
relevant_sections: Surface runoff is precipitation that runs off the landscape
usgs-runoff.scope_note: Gravity moves surface runoff downhill, hard roads encourage runoff, and some rain infiltrates soil. Local fictional drainage geometry is invented, not a factual site report.

mpca-street-sweeping.title: Overview, water quality benefits, and other co-benefits of street sweeping
mpca-street-sweeping.author_or_publisher: Minnesota Pollution Control Agency, Minnesota Stormwater Manual
mpca-street-sweeping.scope_note: Mechanical street sweepers collect roadside sediment and litter using brushes, vacuum mechanisms, or related equipment. The fictional truck is a brush-assisted collection model.

eugene-storm-pipes.title: Piped System Maintenance
eugene-storm-pipes.author_or_publisher: City of Eugene, Oregon, Public Works
relevant_sections: Cleaning the Piped System and Catch Basins
eugene-storm-pipes.scope_note: Catch basins and drainage pipes accumulate debris and sediment and are inspected/cleaned by maintenance crews.

lindenhurst-vacuum-truck.title: New Vacuum Truck for Department of Public Works
relevant_sections: Vacuum cleaning truck and storm-water drainage lines
lindenhurst-vacuum-truck.scope_note: A municipal vacuum truck can pull mud and debris from drainage basins into an enclosed truck body; the story does not specify pressure or capacity.

fhwa-culvert-definition.title: Culvert AOP Definitions
fhwa-culvert-definition.scope_note: A culvert is a drainage structure conveying water, sediment or debris through or beneath a road embankment.

fhwa-drainage-problems.title: Recognizing Drainage Problems
fhwa-drainage-problems.author_or_publisher: Federal Highway Administration, Local Rural Road Maintenance
relevant_sections: Silt or debris accumulation in ditch
Drains blocked by soil and debris
fhwa-drainage-problems.scope_note: Roadside drainage requires inspecting and removing debris and identifying erosion; no preschooler operates machines or works in the ditch.

mvfd-apparatus.title: What are the various equipment on fire apparatuses?
mvfd-apparatus.author_or_publisher: Mount Vernon Fire Department (City of Mount Vernon, New York)
mvfd-apparatus.scope_note: Engine/pumper includes water tank, pump and hoses; ladder apparatus carries aerial ladder and other equipment. Local model and deployment details in the stories are fictional.

pierce-aerial.title: Ascendant 107' Heavy-Duty Aerial Ladder
pierce-aerial.scope_note: An aerial ladder truck uses stabilizers and a powered aerial ladder; the story does not specify this vehicle brand, height, or model.

wa-aerial-stabilizers.title: WAC 296-305-04510 (archived 2024): Automotive fire apparatus, aerial devices
wa-aerial-stabilizers.author_or_publisher: Washington State Legislature, archived Washington Administrative Code
wa-aerial-stabilizers.scope_note: General example of required stabilizer/ground-plate procedures; cited only for the mechanism in a fictional adult-run demonstration, not as current law for a particular jurisdiction.

fdny-protective-gear.title: Protective Gear
fdny-protective-gear.author_or_publisher: FDNY Smart, New York City Fire Department
fdny-protective-gear.scope_note: Identifies firefighter gear and reflective striping. A fox wearing the outfit is fiction, and the scene does not provide operation instructions.

lakeland-fire-education.title: Fire Prevention Education
lakeland-fire-education.author_or_publisher: City of Lakeland Fire Department, Florida
relevant_sections: Meet and Greet with the Fire Engine
lakeland-fire-education.scope_note: Grounds the realistic idea of a public station tour and gentle protective gear demonstration. Does not establish developmental outcomes of these fictional stories.

mndot-plow-training.title: New MnDOT snowplow operators begin training for winter Aug. 17 in Rochester
relevant_sections: Snowplow training and preparation before winter
mndot-plow-training.scope_note: Winter crews prepare vehicles and drivers before storms. Does not describe a named fictional truck or support developmental outcomes.

mndot-winter-maintenance.title: Winter Driving Tips
mndot-winter-maintenance.scope_note: Snowplows are adult-operated road maintenance vehicles, using blades to clear snow from travel lanes. The fictional route and vehicles are not taken from this agency.

mndot-maintenance-questions.title: Frequently Asked Questions — Maintaining Minnesota’s Highways
relevant_sections: Why do we salt the roads in the winter?
What are the limitations of salt?
mndot-maintenance-questions.scope_note: Salt reduces the freezing point of water and its utility depends on road temperature; trained crews choose deicing treatments. Not a recommendation for a specific application quantity.

deere-snow-blade.title: 46-in. (117-cm) Front Blade
relevant_sections: Angling and lifting a tractor front-mounted blade
deere-snow-blade.scope_note: Documents the generic idea of snow-clearing front blade attachments to tractors. The story does not identify a brand, size, or exact compatible model for Farmer Ruth’s existing red tractor.

nws-snow-measure.title: Snow Measurement Guidelines
nws-snow-measure.scope_note: Representative snow depth is measured at several reasonably open, undisturbed spots, not in the deepest drift. Jack’s one informal observation is not an official weather report.

toro-snow-chute.title: Snowthrower Service Manual — Discharge Chute Operation
toro-snow-chute.scope_note: A snowblower accepts snow through its front housing and sends it from a directed chute. The story only depicts adult operation at a protected public walkway.

nymaterials-aggregate-process.title: The Aggregate Mining Process
nymaterials-aggregate-process.scope_note: Distinguishes extracted unconsolidated gravel from crushed rock and describes crushing, sizing, conveying and stockpiling. Does not establish details of the fictional yard or the learning impact of these stories.

sc-quarry-operations.title: Industry Notebook: Quarry Operations
sc-quarry-operations.author_or_publisher: South Carolina Department of Environmental Services
relevant_sections: Loading and Hauling Rock from the Pit
Breaking, Separating and Transporting Rock through the Plant
sc-quarry-operations.scope_note: Describes hauling quarried rock, primary and secondary crushing, screening, recirculation, conveyors and dust control in aggregate operations. The narrative simplifies a generic process.

access-board-stable-trails.title: Outdoor Developed Areas: Chapter 10
relevant_sections: Design tip: building a firm and stable surface
access-board-stable-trails.scope_note: Supports the general idea that properly graded angular crushed rock compacted with a roller can create a stable outdoor surface. Not an engineering specification for the fictional repair.

mec-aggregates-guide.title: Infrastructure and Construction Materials Guide: Aggregates
relevant_sections: Equipment for rock sizing and loading
mec-aggregates-guide.scope_note: General description of quarry equipment, aggregate size reduction and material handling. No claim about any named machine in this invented town.

pitquarry-truck-scales.title: Loadout & Weighing: P&Q University Handbook
pitquarry-truck-scales.scope_note: Truck-scale weight measurement and loadout practice; net payload derives from the loaded and empty vehicle weights. No fictional ticket weights are claimed.
